description: Remove the rule set for an app with set_app_rule, so its new windows open wherever the app puts them again, or where its last window went when that habit is switched on in Plonk. 'app' is the pattern exactly as get_state.app_rules lists it, ignoring case. Fails when no rule matches; nothing else changes.

app.description: The app pattern as listed in get_state.app_rules

name: clear_app_rule
